messages:
sara: quick question — in the Keys form I'm iterating on, should we show inline validation as users type or only after they blur/submit? also wondering about how dense hints should be (we currently have a small hint under every field)

matt: my vote: inline on blur for field-level errors, but only show the global error summary after a failed submit. avoids relentless red while typing. keep hints lighter (one line max) so the form doesn't feel heavy. :+1:

elaine: accessibility note: if we show a summary on submit, move focus to it and use role="alert" or aria-live="assertive" so screen readers announce the error count. linking each item to the field with an anchor is great for keyboard users.

leo: agree with matt/elaine. also for required markers: we should mark required fields with an asterisk + aria-required="true" on the input, but avoid asterisks-only patterns without a legend — add a short line like "* required" at the top. label explicit "(optional)" for optional fields instead of marking all required.

elaine: small add — don't rely on color alone for error states. include an icon or bold text and ensure contrast for error text meets AA.

aria-bot: WCAG tip: error notifications should be programmatically determinable. Success criterion: 4.1.2 name, role, value and 3.3.3 context (when applicable).

matt: microcopy for destructive actions — current modal says "Are you sure?" which is vague. prefer explicit consequence + action naming. e.g.

```
Dialog title: Delete API key "redwood-infer"
Body: This will permanently remove the key. Calls using this key will fail immediately. Type the key name to confirm.
Confirm button: Delete "redwood-infer" (danger)
Cancel: Cancel
```

matt: having the confirm button include the resource name reduces accidental clicks. also require typing the name for production-only ops (like dedicated pool deletes).

leo: on CTA order — follow platform convention: primary is the destructive action on the right with clear red styling, secondary cancel on the left. keep keyboard shortcut ESC to cancel and focus trapping in modal.

sara: re hints — should we collapse the hint content into a single top-level accordion for advanced options? worried about discoverability for novice users.

matt: maybe keep the short hint inline and move longer examples/regex/advanced notes into a flyout or drawer labeled "examples" so we don't overwhelm novices.

elaine: for inline validation timing: validate on blur and on submit. avoid validating on every keystroke except for clearly deterministic checks (e.g., length). if showing inline error after submit, announce it via the summary and for each field set aria-invalid="true".

leo: copy tweak for summary when there are multiple issues: "We found 3 problems with this form. Please fix the following fields." keep short and actionable, then bullets.

sara: awesome. I'll update the mock and include the confirm-copy examples + aria attributes. ping me if you want the Figma link. :rocket:

matt: please add a small prototype for keyboard-only flow — I can test in VoiceOver/NVDA. :thumbsup:

elaine: thanks all — small nits in final review: ensure focus outline is visible on our custom selects and datepickers when error plus required.

aria-bot: saved checklist: [move focus to summary on submit, role=alert on summary, aria-invalid on errored fields, aria-required on required fields, link summary items to fields].
